capabilities: Start, stop and reset the stopwatch
Operate the stopwatch via a button and commands
Display the stopwatch in the sidebar
extras: README is minimal: a one-line description and a bare feature list with no usage examples or screenshots.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in stopwatch, so users cannot track elapsed time without leaving the app.
summary: Sidebar stopwatch that can be started, stopped and reset with a button or commands.
